title: Great People, Great Fun
text: We arrived to find that the sailings for today and the next few days had been cancelled due to bad weather forecasts, however the forecasts were wrong and the weather was beautiful. Somehow our booking was not cancelled, and because of this fact the company was extremely accommodating and gave us a private sailing as well as a wine and cheese tasting class, both of which were thoroughly enjoyable. Every aspect of the day was completed with genuine concern for our enjoyment, and pride in the local customs, cheese, wine and traditions. We loved every minute and would like to congratulate all the
author: Ian_T
